summary: Checked the Expo SDK 57->58 upgrade. package.json has expo ^58.0.0, react-native 0.88.1 and react 19.3.0. `npx expo-doctor@latest` passes 20/20 and `tsc --noEmit` finishes with no errors. Metro builds the iOS bundle (HTTP 200, 11.2MB, valid JS). Backend regression: 9/9 pytest pass. Web E2E at 390x844 passes end to end: splash -> home (EN/HI/BN toggle, pickup/drop inputs, quick chip, demand strip) -> all 5 vehicles selectable -> fare drag changes price (Rs53->Rs60) -> press-hold-book (a 0.5s hold correctly does not book, a 2.3s hold books) -> tracking -> simulate arrival -> finish -> completion (stars, tips) -> back to home. The rating (stars 4, tip 20) and status 'completed' were saved in Mongo. No page errors or console errors. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: stars accepts any integer (no 1-5 bounds) and tip can be negative. Existing behaviour, not caused by the upgrade.
Takes a raw dict with no Pydantic validation. A non-numeric distance_km returns 500. Existing behaviour.

issues: The hero hint 'Tap a bubble to see rides in that spot' is cut off and overlapped by the surge badge ('Streets are calm/busy') at 390px width

react_native_issues.issue: completion.tsx calls router.replace('/home'), which leaves the original home screen in the stack, so 2 home-screen nodes end up in the DOM. A back gesture can return to a stale home. Reference: /app/frontend/app/completion.tsx:35

action_items: Optional: on completion use router.dismissAll() followed by replace, or router.dismissTo('/home'), so home screens do not stack up
Optional: add hitSlop or padding to the star icons and tip chips to reach a 44pt touch target
Optional: fix the overlap between the home hero hint text and the surge badge
critical_code_review_comments: fare.tsx:25 api.fare() has no .catch and no loading/error state. If the request fails, the price stays Rs0 and continue-book can still be pressed with fare 0.
booking.tsx uses the fallbacks 'Home' and 'Rail Bazar' when pickup or drop is empty, so a ride can be booked without the user entering locations. Existing behaviour.
theme.ts uses a local NamedStyles type in place of the removed StyleSheet.NamedStyles. It works and tsc passes.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 rides (1 from pytest, 2 from UI runs). All were deleted by id afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. Expo Router keeps earlier screens hidden in the DOM, so use '[data-testid=...]:visible' selectors. press-hold-book needs mouse.down plus a hold of at least 1.6s. Use mouse drag on fare-thumb to move the slider. Voice STT and the native map were not tested (web shows the SVG fallback).
